title: Boston Marathon Qualifying Standards — BAA
claims: Boston qualifying standards are age- and gender-based net chip times from officially submitted results; the 18–34 men's standard is 2:55:00 and the women's standard is 3:25:00, rising by age group.
The minimum age to qualify is 18 on race day; non-binary athletes are expected to meet the women's standard.
Meeting the standard only qualifies a runner to apply; the accepted field is capped and qualifiers faster than the cutoff may still be turned away.

Certified, measured courses are required; net-downhill time adjustments apply under BAA rules, and a newly measured course must be submitted by the race director and approved by USATF, AIMS or the foreign equivalent.
